basis: ml/runs/njn-v1/cv_results.json (training split only): logreg_mnv3 AUROC 0.888, logreg_cf 0.803, hgb_cf 0.780. Edge uses colour features because they need no on-device runtime and are reproducible in Kotlin; backend uses the best CV model via ONNX Runtime (CPU).
